title: ivesia argyrocoma
intro: Ivesia argyrocoma, commonly known as Mountain Queen's Cup or Gray's ivesia, is a flowering plant that belongs to the Rosaceae family. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help to reduce pain and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Ivesia argyrocoma include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce fever, and act as an anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
